description: Validates a standalone screen inventory has been generated with full traceability to the UI Model and source requirements

checks.description: Standalone screen inventory must exist in the UI Prototype artifact category
checks.remediation: Run screen-generateinventory to produce the screen inventory from ui-model.json and requirements.json

checks.description: Every screen must carry a singular ui_model_ref (never a domain entity directly)
checks.remediation: Ensure every screen references exactly one UI Model entry (UME-[###]) per R-606/R-628 — never a domain entity ID

checks.description: Every screen must carry at least one requirement reference
checks.remediation: Ensure every screen traces to at least one source requirement (R-605); a screen with no supporting requirement should be reconsidered, not silently generated

checks.description: Screen inventory must remain a standalone artifact, not embedded in the consolidated design document
checks.remediation: Per D-6, screen-assembledocument (T08) must reference screen-inventory.md, not duplicate its full per-screen listing inline

checks.description: Inventory must identify the entry screen, planned journeys, and screen-local interactions
checks.remediation: Document planned source/action/target screen IDs, local dialogs, and intentional standalone screens without changing the inventory JSON schema

checks.description: Screen IDs should follow the SCR-[###] convention from ui-prototyping-conventions.md
checks.remediation: Use the SCR-[###] zero-padded 3-digit format defined in artifacts/Documentation/ui-prototyping-conventions.md

checks.description: PRJ-07 integration (conditional): when the project's ui-model.json carries a boundary_ref (produced by ui-generatemodel), every screen's ui_model_ref should resolve to an entry whose boundary_ref names an explicitly software-typed boundary
checks.applies_when: ui-model.json entries carry a boundary_ref field
checks.remediation: This check is soft and conditional — legacy ui-model.json files predating ui-generatemodel (PRJ-07) have no boundary_ref field and are unaffected. When present, a screen tracing to a UIModelEntry whose boundary_ref is non-software or unknown is a model-validatealignment finding (contract Section 2.2/6), not solely this gate's concern — this check exists as an early, non-blocking signal at the screen-inventory stage.
